conditions: The licensee received the Program in object-code or executable form with a written offer that meets section 3(b).
The licensee accompanies the redistributed copy with the received offer information and follows sections 1 and 2 as applicable.
limitations: This claim addresses the section 3(c) option. Sections 3(a) and 3(b) establish separate routes.
Any actual redistribution requires its own applicability assessment.

statement: GNU GPL version 2 section 3(c) permits a licensee redistributing the Program in object-code or executable form under this edition to accompany it with information received about a corresponding-source offer when the redistribution is noncommercial and the licensee received the Program in that form with an offer meeting section 3(b).
